set_aside.subject: owner-only start listener acceptance
set_aside.text: “Until both listeners of step 4 are open, an opened one accepts no connection” contradicts “An owner-only start has no service API listener” and “An owner-only instance: the owner interface served alone”.
set_aside.question: For an owner-only start, does “both listeners” mean every listener applicable to that start, so the owner listener begins accepting once it opens, or does the literal requirement for both listeners prevent it from ever accepting?
options: Treat “both listeners” as all applicable listeners; an owner-only start accepts owner connections once its sole listener is open.
Require two listeners before acceptance; an owner-only start opens its owner listener but never accepts from it.
set_aside.default_guess: Treat the condition as every listener applicable to the start, so the owner-only instance serves its owner interface after that listener opens.

witness.initial: A valid owner-only configuration has no service tokens and no service API address; all configuration, backup-location and store checks pass.
events: No service API listener is opened because the start is owner-only.
The owner connects to the owner-interface listener.
outcomes: Reading “both listeners” literally, the condition can never become true, so the connection remains unaccepted and the owner interface never answers.
Reading it as both listeners when present, or all applicable listeners, the owner connection is accepted and capability:owner_interface.serve_owner_request answers it.
witness.observer: The owner attempting to use the owner interface.
